instruction: Clear all Wikipedia browsing history from my browser to ensure my privacy and remove any record of Wikipedia articles I've viewed.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to clear browsing history for Wikipedia. Uses existing getter 'get_history' and metric 'check_history_deleted' with keyword-based checking. The evaluator verifies that no URLs containing 'wikipedia.org' remain in the browser history after the task is completed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_history' correctly extracts browsing history from Chrome's SQLite database
Metric 'check_history_deleted' correctly verifies that Wikipedia URLs are absent from history by checking for keyword 'wikipedia.org'
Expected keyword 'wikipedia.org' correctly matches all Wikipedia URLs (both www.wikipedia.org and en.wikipedia.org/wiki/*)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure History database is properly flushed before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all requirements in the instruction (clearing Wikipedia browsing history)
Logic flow is sound: get history → check for 'wikipedia.org' keyword → return 1 if not found (deleted), 0 if found (not deleted)
